subject: mathematics
content: Let P be a plane passing through the points (1, 0, 1), (1, $$-$$2, 1) and (0, 1, $$-$$2). Let a vector $$\overrightarrow a  = \alpha \widehat i + \beta \widehat j + \gamma \widehat k$$ be such that $$\overrightarrow a $$ is parallel to the plane P, perpendicular to $$(\widehat i + 2\widehat j + 3\widehat k)$$ and $$\overrightarrow a \,.\,(\widehat i + \widehat j + 2\widehat k) = 2$$, then $${(\alpha  - \beta  + \gamma )^2}$$ equals ____________.
